preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the permutation n is between 2 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(p) == n for n, p in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: Each permutation p has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) for n, p in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation p is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(p)) == n for n, p in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: Each permutation p contains n distinct integers.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= n * (n - 1) // 2 for result, n in zip(results, [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is between 0 and the maximum number of inversions in a permutation of length n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if p[i] > p[j]) == 1 for result, n, p in zip(results, [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: After the minimum number of operations, the permutation has exactly one inversion.
